description: Search reviewed, commercially usable and redistributable SVG icon sets (Tabler, Lucide, Hugeicons Free, Phosphor, Material Icons, Heroicons) pinned to audited upstream revisions. Filter by set, style (outline, filled, solid, regular) or category with Chinese, English or mixed natural-language queries. Returns icon ids, styles, aliases and immutable svg_url values. Follow with get_ui_icon to obtain the verbatim SVG source and license notice instead of redrawing or approximating an icon.

set.description: Optional provider_id from the sets list, such as tabler, lucide, hugeicons, phosphor, material-icons or heroicons.

style.description: Optional style filter such as outline, filled, solid or regular.

name: search_ui_icons
